title: Magmite
body:
Description

Magmite is an uncommon, bright yellow ore found in the Magma Caves within Flameslate nodes.

This ore is unique, as when it is not in contact to heat, it will start cooling down, transitioning to a redder hue up until it completely cools, turning the ore into Obsidian. This process takes 2 Minutes and 45 Seconds to complete, so be sure to keep the ores warm and bring them to a heat source quickly.

To heat up the ore, you can make the ore sit over a lava pool, keep it in contact with Boxed Lava, or put it in a Storage Drawer or Crate, as it will not cool down and will stay the color it is. When this ore is refined or forged, it will no longer cool down, similarly to how Boomite wont explode after refining or forging.

It is recommended to heat the ore until it turns yellow before leaving the cave. While it turns red fast, it stills take some time to turn into obsidian.
